blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: End-to-end control policies trained via Reinforcement Learning (RL) have emerged as an alternative to conventional surgical robotic control approaches, with recent studies exploring state-based policies trained on privileged state observations. However, such approaches rely on precise physical states that are difficult to obtain reliably in surgical environments. Vision-based RL provides an alternative by learning manipulation policies directly from RGB observations, avoiding explicit state estimation and manually engineered perception pipelines while enabling policies to acquire task-relevant visual representations. Nevertheless, obtaining vision-based policies via pure RL methods for surgical manipulation remains challenging. Thus, imitation learning (IL) becomes another solution, yet it requires a large number of expert demonstrations, which are difficult to obtain in minimally invasive surgery. In this work, we propose a framework for state-to-vision policy distillation in laparoscopic robotic manipulation. Specifically, a state-based policy with privileged observations is employed as the teacher, and a vision-based policy learns from RGB observations and robot proprioceptive information, which requires less expert demonstrations than IL and introduces superior performance than RL methods. We conduct extensive experiments on various surgical manipulation tasks in the simulated environment. Experimental results show that, in the context of laparoscopic robotic manipulation, training vision-based policies with general-purpose RL methods is challenging, whereas our proposed state-to-vision policy distillation leads to more consistent and stable performance across tasks.
blocks.zh: 通过强化学习(RL)培训的端到端控制政策已成为常规外科机器人控制方法的替代方法,最近的一些研究探索了以国家为基础的政策,就国家特权观察进行了培训。 然而,这种方法依赖于在外科手术环境中难以可靠获得的精确物理状态. 基于愿景的RL通过直接从RGB观察中学习操纵政策,避免明确状态估计和人工设计感知管道,同时使政策能够获得与任务相关的视觉表现,从而提供了一个替代方案. 然而,通过纯RL方法获得基于视力的政策进行手术操作仍然是一项挑战。 因此,模仿学习(IL)成为另一种解决方案,然而它却需要大量的专家演示,在最小的入侵手术中很难获得. 在这项工作中,我们提出一个框架,用于在大脑机器人操纵中进行国家到视觉政策提炼。 具体来说,采用以国家为主,有特权观察的政策作为教师,以视觉为主的政策从RGB观察和机器人自主信息中学习,这需要的专家演示比IL少,引入的性能优于RL方法. 我们在模拟环境中对各种手术操纵任务进行了广泛的实验. 实验结果表明,在脑膜机器人操纵的情况下,采用通用遥控飞行器方法的基于培训视觉的政策具有挑战性,而我们提议的国对国政策提炼则导致各项任务的绩效更加一致和稳定。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Dexterous manipulation skills are critical components of surgical robotics tasks such as needle insertion, knot tying, and tissue retraction [ 1 ] .
In recent years, significant progress has been made in applying deep reinforcement learning (RL) to accomplish such complex autonomous or semi-autonomous subtasks [ 2 , 3 ] .
This progress has been largely enabled by the development of high-fidelity surgical robot simulators [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] .
However, a key limitation of RL-based surgical robotics lies in its reliance on privileged state information, which typically assumes accurate and noise-free access to the physical states of surgical objects, with limited integration of visual perception [ 10 ] .
This issue is particularly pronounced in fine manipulation tasks such as needle handling, where even minor deviations in object pose can lead to task failure [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh:
Dexterous的操纵技巧是手术机器人任务的关键组成部分,如针插入,结结,和组织收回[1].
近年来,在应用深度强化学习(RL)完成这种复杂的自主或半自主子任务[2,3]方面取得了重大进展.
这一进展在很大程度上得益于高真性手术机器人模拟器的发展[4,5,6,7,8,9].
然而,基于RL的外科机器人的一个关键限制在于其依赖于特权状态信息,通常假定可以准确和无噪声地访问外科物体的物理状态,视觉感知的整合有限[10].
这个问题在针头处理等精细的操纵任务中尤为突出,即使物体摆设的微小偏差也会导致任务故障[2].

blocks.en:
Recently, benchmarks have been proposed to provide a diverse set of learning-based tasks that capture varying levels of dexterity and precision required in the surgical context [ 8 ] .
Benchmarks provide standardized platforms for evaluating autonomous policies. Nevertheless, surgical manipulation tasks still remain highly challenging due to their stringent requirements for precision, robustness, and safety in constrained operating environments.
blocks.zh:
最近提出了基准,以提供一套多样的基于学习的任务,抓住外科手术所需的不同程度的灵活性和精确性[8]。
基准为评估自主政策提供了标准化平台。 尽管如此,手术操作任务仍然具有很大挑战性,因为它们在受限制的操作环境中对精确性、稳健性和安全性提出了严格的要求。

blocks.en:
To reduce the reliance on privileged state information, vision-based policy learning provides an alternative by directly mapping visual observations to control actions [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] .
Such policies can avoid state estimation and manually engineered perception pipelines by leveraging visual information to learn task-relevant representations.
However, learning effective control policies directly from visual observations via RL remains a major hurdle in surgical robotics.
In the context of surgical manipulation tasks, the difficulty is further amplified by the severe visual sparsity of task-relevant objects.
For instance, the needle and instruments of surgical robots often occupy only a few pixels in high-resolution RGB observations, making reliable perception and localization hard to achieve.
Furthermore, the instability of RL exacerbates the training difficulty in such sparse and precision-critical settings [ 14 ] .
Imitation learning (IL) defines a stable training objective, which transforms RL into supervised learning given a large number of expert demonstrations as data labels [ 15 , 16 ] .
However, compared with general robotic manipulation tasks, such as opening bottles or folding clothes, expert demonstrations for laparoscopic manipulation tasks are much more expensive and scarce.
blocks.zh:
为减少对国家特权信息的依赖,基于愿景的政策学习提供了另一种选择,直接绘制视觉观测图以控制行动[11、12、13]。
这些政策可以通过利用视觉信息学习与任务相关的表述,避免国家估计和人工设计感知管道。
然而,直接通过RL从视觉观察中学习有效的控制政策仍然是手术机器人的一大障碍。
在手术操控任务中,由于任务相关对象的视觉严重痉挛,难度进一步扩大.
例如,手术机器人的针头和仪器在高分辨率RGB观测中往往只占据少数像素,使得可靠的感知和本地化难以实现.
此外,RL的不稳定加剧了在如此稀少和精确的关键环境下的培训困难[14]。
模仿学习(IL)定义了一个稳定的训练目标,它将RL转化为有监督的学习,给予大量专家演示作为数据标签[15,16].
然而,与一般的机器人操纵任务(例如打开瓶子或折叠衣物)相比,专家演示的腹腔操纵任务要昂贵得多,而且很少。

blocks.en:
To facilitate vision-based policy learning under these limitations, policy distillation provides an effective approach for transferring knowledge from a state-based policy to an RGB-based policy [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] .
The state-based policy has access to privileged robot and object state information and serves as the teacher, and the RGB-based policy then learns to reproduce the teacher’s behavior from visual observations and robot proprioceptive states.
Such knowledge transfer provides guidance for learning visuomotor policies from high-dimensional visual inputs, enabling the vision-based policy to acquire effective manipulation behaviors without relying on privileged state information during execution.
However, most studies on policy distillation consider discrete action settings, such as those in Atari games, and thus the potential of policy distillation for continuous-control surgical robotic manipulation remains unexplored.
blocks.zh:
为了在这些限制下促进基于愿景的政策学习,政策提炼为将知识从基于国家的政策转移到基于保护责任的政策[17、18、19]提供了一个有效办法。
以州为基础的政策可以获取特权机器人和对象状态信息并担任教师,以RGB为基础的政策然后从视觉观察和机器人自主状态中学习复制教师的行为.
这种知识转让为从高维视觉投入中学习模拟政策提供了指导,使基于视觉的政策能够在执行过程中不依赖特权状态信息的情况下获得有效的操纵行为。
然而,大多数关于政策蒸馏的研究都考虑了诸如阿塔里游戏中的离散动作环境,因此,政策蒸馏对持续控制外科机器人操纵的潜力仍未加以探讨。

blocks.en:
In this work, we propose a policy distillation framework for continuous-control laparoscopic robotic manipulation.
Specifically, we proposed a distribution-matching-based policy learning approach that overcomes the limitation of previous methods by Gaussian alignment. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach through both theoretical analysis and empirical validation.
We employ SurRoL [ 8 ] as the simulation environment, where a Patient Side Manipulator (PSM) executes the manipulation task while an Endoscopic Camera Manipulator (ECM) provides RGB observations.
During training, the state-based policy has access to all privileged state information, including the coordinates and orientations of all objects, and serves as the teacher for the vision-based policy.
In contrast, the vision-based policy only receives RGB observations and robot proprioceptive states, and is trained to distill the behavior of the state-based teacher without accessing privileged object states during execution.
Through theoretical analysis and empirical evaluation, we provide insights into various distribution matching objectives for policy distillation, which may serve as a useful reference for future research on vision-based policy learning in surgical robotics manipulation.
The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows: • We formulate state-to-vision policy distillation as a stochastic distribution matching problem, where a vision-based student policy learns to match both the action and the uncertainty of a privileged state-based teacher policy, reducing the demand for expert demonstrations and demonstrating stronger stability. • We provide a unified first- and second-order gradient analysis of commonly used distribution matching objectives, revealing their distinct gradient scaling, parameter coupling, and curvature properties for Gaussian policies. • We evaluate the proposed method across various surgical robotic manipulation tasks, and the experimental results demonstrate its stronger stability and higher success rate on complex tasks.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们提出了一个持续控制腹腔机器人操纵的政策提炼框架。
具体地说,我们提出了一个基于分配匹配的政策学习方法,克服了高斯调整对以往方法的限制。 我们通过理论分析和经验验证来证明这一方法的有效性。
我们使用 SurRoL [8] 作为模拟环境,一个病人侧操纵器(PSM)执行操纵任务,而一个外景相机(ECM)提供RGB的观测.
在培训期间,基于国家的政策可以获得所有特殊的国家信息,包括所有物体的协调和方向,并担任基于愿景政策的教师。
相比之下,基于视觉的政策只接收RGB的观测和机器人的自制状态,并且经过培训可以提炼基于国家教师的行为,在执行期间不访问特权对象状态.
通过理论分析和实证评价,我们深入了解了政策提炼的各种分布匹配目标,这可作为今后研究外科机器人操纵中基于视觉的政策学习的有益参考。
这项工作的主要贡献概述如下: 我们制定国与国之间的政策提炼,将其作为一个有条理的分布匹配问题,一个基于愿景的学生政策学习与基于特权的国家教师政策的行动和不确定性相匹配,减少对专家示威的需求,并表现出更强的稳定性。 我们对常用分布比对目标进行统一的一阶和二阶梯度分析,揭示其独特的梯度比对,参数结合,以及高斯政策曲率属性. ^ 我们通过各种手术机器人操纵任务来评价拟议方法,实验结果显示其稳定性更强,复杂任务的成功率更高.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Vision-Based Reinforcement Learning
blocks.zh: II-A 基于愿景的强化学习

blocks.en:
Vision-based policies show greater potential for real-world applications because they can prevent the policy from becoming overly reliant on privileged states, but they are more difficult to train due to partial observability and the high dimensionality of image inputs.
To date, there have been numerous studies on how to train vision-based policies.
Asymmetric actor critic [ 20 ] leverages state-based critics to provide target values for vision-based actors, avoiding difficult vision-based critic learning. Nevertheless, asymmetric training may lead to an unbalanced model learning trajectory.
To ensure that both the actor and the critic receive image inputs, Yarats et al. [ 12 , 13 ] developed DrQ and DrQv2 for image-based RL training by introducing an augmentation technique.
Laskin et al. [ 11 ] proposed a method based on contrastive representation learning.
With sufficient expert demonstrations, imitation learning can obtain policies via supervised learning [ 15 , 16 ] ,
whereas the high demand for expert demonstrations is a limitation in the context of surgical robotic manipulation, where expert demonstrations are more expensive and scarce.
These methods all achieve great performance in humanoid robotic control, but are challenged when applied to surgical robotic manipulation.
blocks.zh:
基于愿景的政策显示,现实世界应用的潜力更大,因为它们可以防止政策过分依赖特权国家,但由于部分可观察性和图像投入的高度维度,它们更难训练.
迄今为止,就如何培训基于愿景的政策进行了许多研究。
非对称的演员评论家[20]利用基于国家的批评家为基于视觉的演员提供目标价值,避免困难的基于视觉的批评家学习. 然而,不对称的培训可能导致模式学习轨迹不平衡。
为了确保演员和评论家都能收到图像投入,Yarats等人[12,13]通过引入增强技术,开发了DrQ和DrQv2进行基于图像的RL培训.
Laskin et al. [11] 提出了一种基于对比性代表性学习的方法.
如果有足够的专家示范,模仿学习可以通过监督学习获得政策[15、16],
虽然对专家示威的需求很高,但在手术机器人操纵方面是一个限制,因为专家示威费用更高,而且很少。
这些方法在人造机器人控制中都取得了巨大的性能,但在应用到手术机器人操纵时却受到了挑战.

blocks.en: II-B Learning-Based Surgical Robotic Manipulation
blocks.zh: II-B 基于学习的手术机器人操纵

blocks.en:
To date, most methods focus on state-based policies, where the robotic agent is assumed to have access to the privileged states of objects [ 2 , 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 ] .
Based on state-based policies, surgical robotic manipulation is inevitably solved in two steps: perception and then manipulation.
For example, the agent acquires object states via a hand-crafted image processing pipeline and then feeds the states into the policy network to obtain the robotic actions [ 26 ] .
Such working pipelines are intuitive and simple to deploy in the real world.
Nevertheless, a pure vision-based policy is still an attractive solution because of its one-step processing and stronger robustness against noise and varying scenes.
To this end, some studies start to involve pixel-based observations [ 3 , 27 , 28 , 29 ] .
Haiderbhai et al. [ 3 ] and Gondokaryono et al. [ 28 ] trained RGB-based policies with conventional CNNs and LSTMs for basic manipulation tasks.
To deal with more complex tasks, most vision-based studies depend on additional input observations, such as depth and segmentation masks, which may require extra processing pipelines, or rely on pretrained large models, resulting in high computational costs and potential error propagation.
In this case, how to efficiently obtain a simple and effective vision-based policy remains a problem.
blocks.zh:
迄今为止,大多数方法都侧重于基于国家的政策,其中机器人代理人被假定可以进入物体的特权状态[2,21,22,23,24,25].
基于基于国家的政策,手术机器人操纵不可避免地分两步解决:感知和然后操纵.
例如,代理人通过手动图像处理管道获取对象状态,然后将状态输入政策网络以获得机器人动作[26].
这种工作管道是直观的,在现实世界中部署起来很简单。
然而,纯粹基于远见的政策仍然是一种有吸引力的解决办法,因为它是单步处理的,对噪音和不同场景的强烈性更强。
为此,一些研究开始涉及基于像素的观测[3,27,28,29].
海德拜等人[3]和贡多卡廖诺等人. [28] 与常规CNN和LSTMs一起培训基于RGB的政策,以完成基本的操纵任务.
为了处理更复杂的任务,大多数基于视觉的研究都依赖于额外的输入观测,如深度和分解口罩,这可能需要额外的处理管道,或者依赖于预先训练的大型模型,导致高计算成本和潜在的错误传播.
在这种情况下,如何有效获得简单有效的基于愿景的政策仍然是一个问题。

blocks.en: II-C Policy Distillation
blocks.zh: II-C 政策扭曲

blocks.en:
The concept of policy distillation was first introduced by Rusu et al. [ 18 ] , aiming to transfer the knowledge of multiple task-specific deep Q-networks to a single network.
Czarnecki et al. [ 19 ] further pointed out that the learning trajectory can oscillate once reward learning is involved in the distillation process.
Based on policy distillation, various vision-based policies for real-world manipulation tasks have been developed, by using Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence or Mean Square Error (MSE) to transfer policy knowledge [ 30 , 17 , 31 ] .
In most settings, policy distillation employs one policy as the teacher and another as the student, which can largely avoid the high demand for expert demonstrations, and trains the student policy through relatively stable supervised learning.
We identify that the above properties of policy distillation are more appropriate for surgical vision-based policy training (i.e., low demand for expert demonstrations and a comparatively smooth training trajectory). Furthermore, most studies pertain to discrete action spaces, which cannot be applied to continuous-control laparoscopic robotic manipulation.
These considerations motivate our study.
blocks.zh:
政策蒸馏的概念最早由Rusu等人提出. [18],旨在将多个任务特异性的深度Q网络知识转移到一个单一网络.
Charnecki等人[19]进一步指出,一旦奖励学习参与蒸馏过程,学习轨迹就可能发生偏振.
在政策提炼的基础上,通过利用Kullback-Leibler(KL)difference或Mean Square Error(MSE)转让政策知识[30、17、31],制定了各种基于愿景的关于现实世界操纵任务的政策。
在多数情况下,政策提炼采用一种政策作为教师,另一种政策作为学生,这可以在很大程度上避免对专家示威的高需求,并通过相对稳定的监督学习来培训学生政策.
我们确认,政策提炼的上述特性更适合于基于视觉的外科政策培训(即对专家示范的需求低,培训轨迹相对平稳)。 此外,大多数研究涉及离散的动作空间,这些空间不能用于连续控制腹腔机器人操纵。
这些考虑促使我们进行研究。

blocks.en: III-B State-to-Vision Policy Distillation

blocks.en:
We revisit the SAC algorithm and observe that its learned Gaussian policy is particularly well-suited to distillation. Unlike conventional distillation methods that compute various divergence measures via Monte-Carlo estimators, the SAC policy explicitly models both the mean μ \mu and the standard deviation σ \sigma , enabling closed-form distillation between teacher and student policies.
Therefore, the discrepancy between the teacher and student policies can be accurately measured in the distribution space, providing a more deterministic and interpretable optimization.
Moreover, the predicted standard deviation explicitly characterizes the uncertainty of the policy, allowing the student to learn both the action tendency and the confidence of the teacher behavior. Such uncertainty-aware policy transfer may lead to learning behaviors that differ from those of the conventional mean-only transfer.

blocks.en:
Given the stochastic Gaussian policies of the teacher and student, state-to-vision policy transfer can be formulated as a distribution matching problem. Specifically, we seek to minimize a divergence or distance between the two policies, such as the Wasserstein Distance (WD) and the Kullback-Leibler (KL) Divergence.
Forward KL (FKL) divergence is a prevalent technique in various deep learning fields, such as model distillation, knowledge transfer, and representation alignment. Its Gaussian closed form is defined as: D FKL ​ ( π t , π s ) = D KL ( π t | | π s ) = log ⁡ ( σ s σ t ) + σ t 2 + ( μ t − μ s ) 2 2 ​ σ s 2 − 0.5 . \begin{split}D_{\text{FKL}}(\pi_{t},\pi_{s})&=D_{\text{KL}}(\pi_{t}||\pi_{s})\\

D_{\text{RKL}}(\pi_{t},\pi_{s})=D_{\text{KL}}(\pi_{s}||\pi_{t}). (9) Although RKL is not a prevalently used method for distillation, we investigate it to gain more insights into how the uncertainty influences the learning behavior.
FKL and RKL measure the discrepancy between the teacher and student policies, but their asymmetric formulations lead to distinct optimization behaviors. FKL exhibits a mode-covering tendency, which may encourage the student policy to increase its variance to cover the probability mass of the teacher distribution. In contrast, RKL exhibits a mode-seeking tendency, favoring concentrated distributions and potentially underestimating the uncertainty of the policy action [ 19 , 34 ] . blocks.en: IV Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 四. 实验和结果

blocks.en: IV-A Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 四.A 执行细节

blocks.en:
All experiments are conducted in the SurRoL simulator [ 8 ] .
The teacher policy receives privileged state information, including the coordinates and orientations of objects such as the PSM, needles, and gauze, whereas the student policy takes RGB frames from the ECM along with only the PSM gripper coordinates, without access to the states of other objects.
All state policies are implemented as three-layer MLPs, and all RGB policies are implemented with three convolutional layers and three fully connected layers similar to those of CURL [ 11 ] and DrQ [ 12 ] .
The teacher policy is first trained using Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) with the default hyperparameter settings [ 33 ] , including the learning rate, the discount factor, etc.
After training, the teacher policy is frozen and used
to provide supervision for training the vision-based student policy.
In particular, the JD loss is scaled by 0.5 0.5 to align its gradient magnitude with those of the other distribution matching objectives for fairness.
To reduce experimental time costs, WD is not implemented separately because it shares the similar learning objective as MSE.
The success rate for each evaluation is reported over 100 independent trials.
Each experiment is independently repeated five times using different random seeds.
All results are reported as averages across the five runs.
Student policies trained by different loss distillation methods utilize the same teacher policy.
All methods are trained via the Adam optimizer with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , a batch size of 64, and 5 × 10 5 5\times 10^{5} iterations.
During training, we periodically evaluate the policy every 1000 iterations and save the checkpoint with the highest reward for subsequent evaluation.
For more implementation details, please visit https://github.com/MingyuShengSMY/SurgiPD.git .

blocks.en: IV-B Results Comparison Across Different Tasks
blocks.zh: 四-B 不同任务的成果比较

blocks.en:
Success rates of various methods under different tasks are shown in Table II .
For pure RL-based vision methods (e.g., CURL and DrQv2), their performances are good on the simplest task (i.e., NeedleReach), whereas their effectiveness is significantly challenged when facing more complex tasks, such as NeedlePick and NeedleRegrasp where more dexterous manipulations are involved.
ALOHA demonstrates superior performance on NeedleReach, GauzeRetrieve, and NeedlePick, but also exhibits performance degradation on more challenging tasks (i.e., PegTransfer and NeedleRegrasp).
In terms of policy distillation, although its performance is similar to that of other methods on the simple manipulation task (i.e., NeedleReach), and slightly worse than ALOHA on GauzeRetrieve and NeedlePick, it can maintain a success rate of about 70% on complex manipulation tasks, showing relatively stronger stability and robustness.
blocks.zh:
不同任务下各种方法的成功率见表二。
对于纯基于RL的视觉方法(如CURL和DrQv2)来说,他们的性能在最简单的任务(即NeedleReach)上是好的,而当面临更复杂的任务时,其有效性则受到很大挑战,比如NeedlePick和NeedleRegrasp,其中涉及到更狡猾的操纵.
ALOHA在NeedleReach,GauzeRetrieve和NeedlePick上表现优异,但也在更具挑战性的任务(即Peg Transfer和NeedleRegrasp)上表现出性能退化.
在政策提炼方面,虽然其性能与其他简单操控任务(即NeedleReach)上的方法相似,也略逊于ALOHA在GauzeRetrieve和NeedlePick上,但是在复杂的操控任务上可以保持约70%的成功率,显示出相对更强的稳定性和稳健性.

blocks.en: IV-C Results Comparison Across Different Distillations
blocks.zh: 四-C 不同蒸馏量的成果比较

blocks.en:
To investigate the contributions of different distillation settings, we evaluate and compare the performances of FKL, RKL, JD, and MSE across various tasks (see Table II ).
Specifically, noticeably inferior performance is observed for RKL on NeedlePick, at 39.8%, showing its potential instability.
Recalling the gradient equation of RKL in Table I , we hypothesize that the instability may result from the combined effects of the prior-scaled gradient (discussed in Section III-E ) and the high certainty of the teacher policy, whose standard deviation is empirically around 0.3 in our experiments.
In this case, the gradient is amplified threefold, and thus may cause gradient oscillation and lower performance.
blocks.zh:
为了调查不同蒸馏环境的贡献,我们评价和比较FKL、RKL、JD和MSE在不同任务中的性能(见表二)。
具体而言,NeedlePick上的RKL的性能明显较低,为39.8%,显示出其潜在的不稳定性。
回顾表一中RKL的梯度方程,我们假设不稳定性可能来自先前梯度(第三至E节讨论)和教师政策的高度确定性的综合影响,在我们的实验中,教师政策的标准偏差在0.3左右。
在这种情况下,梯度被放大三倍,从而可能导致梯度振荡和性能降低.

blocks.en:
Uncertainty-adaptive distillations (i.e., FKL and JD) usually outperform non-adaptive ones (i.e., RKL and MSE) on complex tasks (see PegTransfer and NeedleRegrasp in Table II ).
On the other hand, for simpler tasks, such as NeedleReach and GauzeRetrieve, there is no significant enhancement gained from uncertainty adaptation.
This observation suggests the potential effectiveness of uncertainty adaptation for complex laparoscopic manipulation tasks.
blocks.zh:
在复杂的任务上,不确定的适应性蒸馏(即FKL和JD)通常优于非适应性蒸馏(即RKL和MSE)(见表二中的Peg Transfer和NeedleRegrasp).
另一方面,对于NeedleReach和GauzeRetrieve等较简单的任务,没有从不确定性适应中获得显著增强.
这一看法表明,在复杂的腹腔操纵任务中,对不确定性的适应具有潜在效力。

blocks.en: Comparing FKL and JD, the performance of JD is slightly better than that of FKL across different tasks to varying degrees, corresponding to the Hessian matrix analysis in Section III-F , where JD features a broader convex optimization landscape that benefits the training.
blocks.zh: 比较FKL和JD,JD的性能略优于FKL不同任务不同程度的性能,与第三-F节的黑森矩阵分析相对应,JD具有更广泛的对流优化景观,有利于培训.

blocks.en: IV-D Feature Map Analysis
blocks.zh: IV-D 地貌图分析

blocks.en:
To understand what visual cues the policy relies on, we visualize the CNN feature maps, i.e., the output of the last convolutional layer.
As shown in Fig. 3 , high activations consistently concentrate on the gripper and the target object, while background regions remain weakly activated.
Moreover, these high-activation regions follow the gripper and object as their positions change, rather than staying fixed to image coordinates.
This indicates that the CNN learns task-relevant semantic representations encoding the relative spatial configuration between the gripper and the object, explaining for the robustness to object position changes.
blocks.zh:
为了了解这个政策所依赖的视觉提示,我们将CNN的特征地图,即最后一个演化层的输出进行视觉化.
如图3所示,高激活率始终集中在抓取器和目标物体上,而背景区域仍然很少激活。
此外,这些高活性区域随着其位置的改变而紧跟在钳子和物体上,而不是固定在图像坐标上。
这表明CNN学习了与任务相关的语义表达法,编码了夹子和物体之间的相对空间配置,解释了物体位置变化的稳健性.

blocks.en: IV-E Conclusion
blocks.zh: 四-E 结论

blocks.en:
In this study, we propose a policy distillation framework for visuomotor laparoscopic robotic manipulation tasks, which can transfer policy knowledge from a state-based policy to a vision-based policy through distribution matching objectives.
Our experimental results in the SurRoL simulator demonstrate that our method shows superior performance and robustness on relatively complex manipulation tasks.
We also observe the potential effectiveness of the uncertainty adaptation mechanism by comparing different distillation objectives, and investigate the intermediate feature maps to show their capability of task-relevant semantic understanding.
Although our experiments are conducted in the SurRoL simulator, existing works indicate that transferring such policies to real hardware is viable via sim-to-real methods, such as domain randomization [ 8 , 36 , 37 ] .
Furthermore, in this work, we only utilize a simple network architecture consisting of three convolutional layers and three fully connected layers, without relying on advanced mechanisms such as attention, multi-scales, and mixture-of-experts, and only leverage RGB frames and robot posture states as input, indicating the potential scalability to further enhance performance.
blocks.zh:
在这项研究中,我们提议一个政策提炼框架,用以完成轮式机器人操纵任务,通过分配匹配目标,将政策知识从基于国家的政策转移到基于愿景的政策。
我们在SurRoL模拟器的实验结果表明,我们的方法在相对复杂的操纵任务上表现出了优异的性能和坚韧性.
我们还通过比较不同的蒸馏目标来观察不确定性适应机制的潜在效力,并调查中间特征图,以显示其与任务相关的语义理解能力。
虽然我们的实验是在SurRoL模拟器中进行的,但现有的作品表明,通过sim-to-real方法,例如域随机化[8,36,37],将此类政策转移到真正的硬件上是可行的.
此外,在这项工作中,我们只利用由三个演化层和三个全连接层组成的简单的网络架构,而不依赖注意,多尺度,专家混合等先进机制,并且只能利用RGB帧和机器人姿态状态作为投入,表明潜在的可扩展性来进一步提高性能.
